prompts.prompt: A single set of footprints crossing a wide dew-covered meadow toward a distant city skyline on the horizon, conveying that one small daily step can change the planet. Vertical phone-screen composition with the horizon in the upper third and the lower half left almost empty and pale so that headline and body text can sit over it. Shot as an ordinary candid snapshot of a real place rather than a polished advertising or stock-styled photograph: everyday imperfection is wanted — slightly off-centre and imperfect framing, uneven ambient light, ordinary well-used everyday objects with scuffs, dust and wear, a little untidy clutter left in frame, nothing arranged, styled, colour-corrected or retouched. Realistic documentary photography in the manner of a free stock-photo library, not illustration: full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at f/5.6, soft diffused natural daylight, natural unretouched surface texture and true-to-life material detail, moderate detail density with generous calm areas left uncluttered, loosely harmonized with #117F87 deep teal and #E0F2F1 pale celadon as a gentle undertone rather than a strict palette, natural variation in exposure, ambient colour and framing between images is welcome and expected, calm and hopeful and grounded in the everyday, absolutely no illustration, no painterly brushwork, no watercolour or hand-drawn line, no 3D render or CGI look, no high-key blown-out whiteness and no shallow-bokeh cinematic treatment
